sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九隐形。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Trophies are hard for people to throw away.
sentences.zh: 奖杯对人们来说很难舍得扔掉。

sentences.en: There's actually a service in Madison, Wisconsin that will recycle your old trophies and turn them into new ones.
sentences.zh: 威斯康星州麦迪逊市其实有一家机构，会回收你的旧奖杯并将其变成新奖杯。

sentences.en: They replace the nameplates, they polish them up, and then donate them to non-profits like the Boys and Girls Club or the Special Olympics.
sentences.zh: 他们会更换铭牌，将其抛光，然后捐赠给诸如男女孩童俱乐部或特殊奥林匹克运动会等非营利组织。

sentences.en: Some of the trophies they get come from people who have passed away.
sentences.zh: 他们收到的一些奖杯来自已经去世的人。

sentences.en: Their surviving relatives send them.
sentences.zh: 由他们健在的亲属寄来。

sentences.en: And sometimes they're from people who are just tired of their trophies taking up space in their homes.
sentences.zh: 有时则来自那些只是厌倦了奖杯在家中占据空间的人。

sentences.en: In both cases, people will actually pay the shipping to Madison to avoid putting their trophies in the trash.
sentences.zh: 在这两种情况下，人们甚至会支付运费将奖杯寄到麦迪逊，以免把它们扔进垃圾桶。

sentences.en: Donna Gray, who runs this service with her daughter Janet, says that sometimes people request to be told where their old trophies end up.
sentences.zh: 唐娜·格雷与女儿珍妮一起经营这项服务，她说有时人们会要求被告知他们的旧奖杯最终流向何处。

sentences.en: Almost like they're donating an organ.
sentences.zh: 简直就像他们在捐赠器官一样。

sentences.en: Most of the time, the materials that make them are cheap.
sentences.zh: 大多数时候，制作它们的材料都很便宜。

sentences.en: But that's not how you measure the value of a trophy.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是衡量奖杯价值的方式。

sentences.en: There's a little trophy shop down the street from our office in Oakland.
sentences.zh: 在我们奥克兰办公室的街角有一家小奖杯店。

sentences.en: It's small but bustling.
sentences.zh: 它很小，但生意兴隆。

sentences.en: And its windows are stuffed to the brim with awards made of all kinds of materials.
sentences.zh: 它的橱窗里塞满了各种材料制作的奖品。

sentences.en: And in any shape you can imagine.
sentences.zh: 而且形状包罗万象。

sentences.en: Chalices.
sentences.zh: 圣杯。

sentences.en: Orbs.
sentences.zh: 圆球。

sentences.en: Golfers.
sentences.zh: 高尔夫球手。

sentences.en: Gavels.
sentences.zh: 法官木槌。

sentences.en: Apples.
sentences.zh: 苹果。

sentences.en: And plaques.
sentences.zh: 还有牌匾。

sentences.en: Plenty of plaques.
sentences.zh: 各种各样的牌匾。

sentences.en: So, of course, producer Avery Truffleman read them.
sentences.zh: 所以，不出所料，制作人埃弗里·特鲁夫曼读了它们。

sentences.en: We, the membership of Mount Zion Lodge No.
sentences.zh: 我们，锡安山4号分会的全体会员，

sentences.en: 4, present this token of appreciation to Brother Willie AdaMs.
sentences.zh: 将此感激之情呈献给威利·亚当斯兄弟。

sentences.en: We honor and welcome you.
sentences.zh: 我们向你致敬并表示欢迎。

sentences.en: Oh, Freemason.
sentences.zh: 哦，共济会员。

sentences.en: Are they allowed to reveal who that is?
sentences.zh: 他们被允许透露那是谁吗？

sentences.en: Honorable Award of Excellence presented to Gavin Newsom, Mayor of San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 表彰卓越荣誉奖，颁发给旧金山市长加文·纽森。

sentences.en: An appreciation for your contributions to the Nigerian community.
sentences.zh: 感谢您为尼日利亚社区做出的贡献。

sentences.en: Club DJ of the Year in 1990.
sentences.zh: 1990年度俱乐部DJ。

sentences.en: There's one that just says Rifle Expert.
sentences.zh: 有一个上面只写着步枪专家。

sentences.en: And there are plenty of touchingly heartfelt engravings that you feel that maybe you shouldn't be reading.
sentences.zh: 还有许多触动人心的深情刻字，让你觉得也许自己不该去读它们。

sentences.en: To my dear husband, Gil, on the occasion of our 35th wedding anniversary.
sentences.zh: 献给我亲爱的丈夫吉尔，在我们结婚35周年纪念日之际。

sentences.en: Thank you, sweetheart, for 35 loving, supportive, challenging, and exciting years together.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，亲爱的，35年来我们一起度过充满爱、支持、挑战和精彩的岁月。

sentences.en: God has knitted our hearts together into a beautiful tapestry of love.
sentences.zh: 上帝将我们的心编织在一起，成为一幅美丽的爱之织锦。

sentences.en: Julia Rydell runs this shop, along with her husband.
sentences.zh: 尤利娅·里德尔和她的丈夫一起经营这家店。

sentences.en: And she's always moved by what people want engraved on their trophies.
sentences.zh: 人们想在奖杯上刻什么，总是让她感动。

sentences.en: People amaze me with eloquence and the sincerity and just the way that they can express their feelings.
sentences.zh: 人们的口才、真诚以及表达感情的方式让我惊叹。

sentences.en: Because I am from the culture where people did not express their feelings publicly.
sentences.zh: 因为我来自一个人们不会公开表达感情的文化背景。

sentences.en: Julia is from Russia.
sentences.zh: 尤利娅来自俄罗斯。

sentences.en: And it was not always appreciated when people would just express sincerely their feelings,
sentences.zh: 在那里，人们真诚地表达感情并不总是受到赞赏，

sentences.en: let alone have them engraved and be displayed publicly.
sentences.zh: 更不用说把它们刻下来并公开展示了。

sentences.en: Russians just don't give out trophies the way that we do.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯人根本不会像我们这样颁发奖杯。

sentences.en: Americans freaking love trophies.
sentences.zh: 美国人简直爱死奖杯了。

sentences.en: And some of the fanciest trophies in Julia's shop, actually some of the fanciest trophies in the world,
sentences.zh: 而尤利娅店里的一些精美奖杯，实际上也是世界上最精美的一些奖杯，

sentences.en: come from R.S.
sentences.zh: 产自芝加哥的R.S.

sentences.en: Owens & Company in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 欧文斯公司。

sentences.en: My father built the company, and his first figure was a guinea pig figure that he manufactured.
sentences.zh: 我父亲建立了这家公司，他的第一个作品是他制造的一个豚鼠造型。

sentences.en: For guinea pig breeding competitions during the Great Depression,
sentences.zh: 那是为大萧条时期的豚鼠繁育比赛制作的，

sentences.en: R.S.
sentences.zh: R.S.

sentences.en: Owens has since moved well beyond the humble guinea pig trophy.
sentences.zh: 欧文斯此后早已远超那个简陋的豚鼠奖杯。

sentences.en: Scott Siegel's father was the founder of R.S.
sentences.zh: 斯科特·西格尔的父亲是R.S.

sentences.en: Owens & Company.
sentences.zh: 欧文斯公司的创始人。

sentences.en: And Scott showed me around the factory, like a real bona fide factory,
sentences.zh: 斯科特带我参观了这家工厂，一个货真价实的工厂，

sentences.en: with big kilns for the glass plaques and wheeled carts full of castings and statuettes
sentences.zh: 里面有用于玻璃牌匾的大型窑炉、装满铸件和小雕像的手推车，

sentences.en: and rows and rows of industrial-grade buffers.
sentences.zh: 还有一排又一排工业级的抛光机。

sentences.en: This is just some of what we do here.
sentences.zh: 这只是我们在这里所做的一部分工作。

sentences.en: Their massive showroom is full of crazy different kinds of trophies and awards.
sentences.zh: 他们巨大的陈列室里摆满了各种各样疯狂的不同类型的奖杯和奖品。

sentences.en: This was for NASCAR.
sentences.zh: 这是为纳斯卡赛车制作的。

sentences.en: This is the only time we've made an award with a built-in DVD player.
sentences.zh: 这是我们唯一一次制作带有内置DVD播放器的奖品。

sentences.en: Gimmicks aside, R.S.
sentences.zh: 抛开噱头不谈，R.S.

sentences.en: Owens makes some truly iconic trophies.
sentences.zh: 欧文斯制作了一些真正标志性的奖杯。

sentences.en: That's the Emmy over there.
sentences.zh: 那边就是艾美奖。

sentences.en: Yes, an Emmy award.
sentences.zh: 是的，一个艾美奖奖杯。

sentences.en: But the Emmy is outshined by its neighbor.
sentences.zh: 但艾美奖的光芒被它的邻居掩盖了。

sentences.en: I can't believe that's a real Oscar.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信那是真的奥斯卡奖杯。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a real Oscar.
sentences.zh: 对，是真的奥斯卡。

sentences.en: The Oscar's real name is the Academy Award of Merit,
sentences.zh: 奥斯卡的真名是学院功绩奖，

sentences.en: but it is now officially known by its nickname.
sentences.zh: 但现在它以其昵称而广为人知。

sentences.en: There's lots of mythology around where the name Oscar came from,
sentences.zh: 关于奥斯卡这个名字的来历有很多神话传说，

sentences.en: but the official myth is that the Academy librarian, Margaret Herrick,
sentences.zh: 但官方的传说是学院图书管理员玛格丽特·赫里克

sentences.en: took a look at the statue and whispered,
sentences.zh: 看了一眼这座雕像并低声说道，

sentences.en: The first Oscar was awarded in 1929,
sentences.zh: 第一座奥斯卡奖于1929年颁发，

sentences.en: and a number of different factories have manufactured the Oscars over the years.
sentences.zh: 多年来，许多不同的工厂都制造过奥斯卡奖杯。

sentences.en: R.S.
sentences.zh: R.S.

sentences.en: Owens has been making them since 1983.
sentences.zh: 欧文斯自1983年以来一直在制作它们。

sentences.en: When I saw the Oscar, it was hard to believe that I was looking at the real deal,
sentences.zh: 当我看到奥斯卡时，很难相信我看到的是真品，

sentences.en: because I'd seen so many knockoffs.
sentences.zh: 因为我见过太多的山寨货了。

sentences.en: The design itself isn't hard to imitate.
sentences.zh: 设计本身并不难模仿。

sentences.en: It's really simple.
sentences.zh: 它真的很简单。

sentences.en: It's mostly just that stylized gold man standing on a reel of film.
sentences.zh: 主要就是一个站在电影胶片盘上的风格化金色小金人。

sentences.en: Actually, MGM art director Cedric Gibbons originally designed the statue as a knight
sentences.zh: 事实上，米高梅艺术总监塞德里克·吉本斯最初将这座雕像设计为一名骑士，

sentences.en: gripping a crusader's sword.
sentences.zh: 手持十字军宝剑。

sentences.en: And the Oscar has been purposefully designed to be as desirable an object as possible.
sentences.zh: 而且奥斯卡在设计上就是为了成为尽可能令人向往的物品。

sentences.en: There's more gold on the Oscar than in any other award by far.
sentences.zh: 奥斯卡上的黄金含量远远超过任何其他奖项。

sentences.en: There's more gold on the Oscar than any other award we make.
sentences.zh: 我们制作的任何其他奖项上的黄金都没有奥斯卡来得多。

sentences.en: Also, it's really hefty.
sentences.zh: 而且，它真的很重。

sentences.en: It's eight and a half pounds and it's crazy shiny.
sentences.zh: 它有八点五磅重，而且闪闪发光得惊人。

sentences.en: A lot of polishing goes into it.
sentences.zh: 里面包含了大量的抛光工序。

sentences.en: Obviously, it has to be defect free.
sentences.zh: 显然，它必须毫无瑕疵。

sentences.en: So, that takes a lot of time.
sentences.zh: 所以，这需要花费大量的时间。

sentences.en: How much time?
sentences.zh: 需要多少时间？

sentences.en: To polish each one?
sentences.zh: 抛光每一个？

sentences.en: Over an hour.
sentences.zh: 一个多小时。

sentences.en: Oh, man.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: When I saw it, I just wanted it.
sentences.zh: 当我看到它时，我只想拥有它。

sentences.en: It was like primal almoSt.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉几乎是原始的。

sentences.en: But somehow Scott Siegel resists the urge to make one for himself.
sentences.zh: 但不知何故，斯科特·西格尔忍住了为自己做一个的冲动。

sentences.en: A lot of people ask me about whether I have an Oscar at home and are surprised that I don't.
sentences.zh: 很多人问我家里有没有奥斯卡，并且对没有感到惊讶。

sentences.en: And I've never even been interested in having an Oscar at home.
sentences.zh: 我甚至从未对家里摆一个奥斯卡感兴趣。

sentences.en: That's exactly what he would say if he had an Oscar at home.
sentences.zh: 如果他家里真有一个奥斯卡，他也会这么说的。

sentences.en: But some people do make awards for themselves.
sentences.zh: 但有些人确实会为自己制作奖项。

sentences.en: People do make awards for themselves.
sentences.zh: 人们确实会为自己制作奖项。

sentences.en: Back in Oakland, Julia gets customers who don't look very athletic at all
sentences.zh: 回到奥克兰，尤利娅接待了一些看起来一点也不爱运动的顾客，

sentences.en: picking up trophies that say they are number one in running.
sentences.zh: 他们来取上面写着自己是跑步第一名的奖杯。

sentences.en: Or elderly customers buying a trophy for being a young beauty queen or world traveler.
sentences.zh: 或者老年顾客买一个奖杯来纪念自己曾是年轻选美冠军或世界旅行者。

sentences.en: And this has happened multiple times?
sentences.zh: 而且这发生过不止一次？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Oh, yes.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Quite multiple.
sentences.zh: 相当多次。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's a common thing.
sentences.zh: 这是一件很常见的事。

sentences.en: Julia is so not judgmental about this.
sentences.zh: 尤利娅对此一点也不评判。

sentences.en: If giving yourself an award makes you feel better, she's all for it.
sentences.zh: 如果给自己颁奖能让你感觉更好，她完全支持。

sentences.en: It's a way of validating your own experience.
sentences.zh: 这是肯定你自己经历的一种方式。

sentences.en: And even more validating than making yourself an award is making yourself an entire awards
sentences.zh: 比给自己做一个奖杯更具肯定意义的是给自己办一场完整的颁奖

sentences.en: ceremony.
sentences.zh: 典礼。

sentences.en: Welcome to MTV Music Television.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到MTV音乐电视台。

sentences.en: Young MTV decided to establish itself with an awards ceremony because that's a great way
sentences.zh: 年轻的MTV决定通过颁奖典礼来确立自己的地位，因为这是快速吸引大量观众、获得高收视率并引入强大明星阵容的好方法。

sentences.en: to quickly attract a lot of viewers, get high ratings, and bring in a lot of star power.
sentences.zh: 他们希望通过一座非常棒的奖杯来进一步巩固自己的地位。

sentences.en: And they wanted to further establish themselves with a really good trophy.
sentences.zh: 我是帕特·戈尔曼，我设计了月球人雕像。

sentences.en: I'm Pat Gorman, and I designed the Moon Man statue.
sentences.zh: 那个在MTV音乐录影带大奖（即VMAs）上颁发的银色宇航员。

sentences.en: That silver astronaut given out at the MTV Video Music Awards, or VMAs.
sentences.zh: 帕特·戈尔曼是曼哈顿设计事务所的成员，该事务所创造了MTV的标志。

sentences.en: Pat Gorman was part of Manhattan Design, the firm that created the MTV logo.
sentences.zh: 但制作这个奖杯实现了她长久以来的梦想。

sentences.en: But making this trophy fulfilled a longtime dream of hers.
sentences.zh: 我和姐姐曾是双人杖操冠军。

sentences.en: I had been a champion baton twirler with my sister.
sentences.zh: 我们有一个双人表演节目，家里有所有这些小奖项，我想过，

sentences.en: We had like a doubles routine, and we have all these little awards at home, and I thought,
sentences.zh: 我一生中想制作一个伟大的奖杯，然后这就是机会。

sentences.en: I wanted to make a great trophy sometime in my life, and then this would be the chance.
sentences.zh: 于是曼哈顿设计事务所推敲了几个想法。

sentences.en: So Manhattan Design kicked around a few ideas.
sentences.zh: 但最终，帕特意识到完美的奖杯应该是一座登月之人的雕像。

sentences.en: But eventually, Pat realized that the perfect trophy would be a statue of a man on the moon.
sentences.zh: 女士们先生们，摇滚乐。

sentences.en: Ladies and gentlemen, rock and roll.
sentences.zh: 对于你们这些没有经历过的人，埃弗里，MTV在整点时会播放一个小型的台标宣传短片。

sentences.en: For those of you who weren't around, Avery, MTV played a little station ID clip at the top of the hour.
sentences.zh: 人类在月球着陆并插上MTV旗帜的画面。

sentences.en: Where the man lands on the moon and plants the MTV flag.
sentences.zh: 那是登月的经典历史影像。

sentences.en: It was vintage footage of the moon landing.
sentences.zh: 但宇航员插上的不是美国国旗，而是一面写着MTV的旗帜。

sentences.en: But instead of planting an American flag, the astronaut had a flag that said MTV.
sentences.zh: 我想，好吧，我们就把它用作雕像吧。

sentences.en: I thought, well, let's use that as a statue.
sentences.zh: 我还想让这座雕像看起来像是在漂浮。

sentences.en: And I also wanted to make the statue look like it was floating.
sentences.zh: 因此，帕特设计了一个宇航员形象，穿着有褶皱的阿波罗宇航服，单腿平衡，手里拿着一面写着MTV的小旗子。

sentences.en: So Pat designed an astronaut figure in a wrinkly Apollo suit balancing on one leg, holding a little flag that said MTV.
sentences.zh: 她画了一些草图，并把它们交给了制造商。

sentences.en: She drew up some sketches, and she gave them to a manufacturer.
sentences.zh: 然后她两周后回来。

sentences.en: And then she comes back two weeks later.
sentences.zh: 他说，这是你的雕像。

sentences.en: And he says, here's your statue.
sentences.zh: 我一看，根本不是那么回事。

sentences.en: I look, and it didn't look anything.
sentences.zh: 那是一个家伙双脚稳稳地站着，在行军礼。

sentences.en: It was, there was a guy standing with his feet firmly planted, and he's saluting.
sentences.zh: 我说，他在向谁敬礼？

sentences.en: I said, what's he saluting?
sentences.zh: 那里什么也没有。

sentences.en: There's nothing there.
sentences.zh: 帕特觉得，这完全不可接受。

sentences.en: Pat's like, this is totally unacceptable.
sentences.zh: 你必须按照我的草图来做。

sentences.en: You've got to follow my sketch.
sentences.zh: 你必须按照我的草图来做。

sentences.en: And the manufacturer goes back to work.
sentences.zh: 然后制造商重新开工。

sentences.en: We come back in a week, and now I see something even more bizarre.
sentences.zh: 我们一周后回来，现在我看到了更离奇的东西。

sentences.en: I see a man in a leisure suit.
sentences.zh: 我看到一个穿休闲西装的男人。

sentences.en: He's got this whole thing smoothed out.
sentences.zh: 他把这整套衣服弄得平平整整。

sentences.en: There's not a wrinkle in the suit.
sentences.zh: 西装上连一丝褶皱都没有。

sentences.en: Also, this leisure suit moon man was still not on one leg.
sentences.zh: 而且，这个穿休闲西装的登月人依然没有用单脚站立。

sentences.en: And the manufacturer insisted, nope, can't happen.
sentences.zh: 制造商却坚持说，不，这不可能。

sentences.en: It won't balance.
sentences.zh: 它无法平衡。

sentences.en: We only have one more week, and that's it.
sentences.zh: 我们只剩最后一周了，就是这样。

sentences.en: And they've got to be cast, like, tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 而且它们差不多明天就得开始铸造。

sentences.en: So I just asked him for clay, and I started building it.
sentences.zh: 所以我向他要了些黏土，开始制作起来。

sentences.en: Pat teamed up with a friend who was a potter.
sentences.zh: 帕特找了一个做陶器的朋友合作。

sentences.en: And they made a mold of the guy standing on one leg holding the MTV flag, and it balanced.
sentences.zh: 他们做了一个模具，雕刻出单脚站立并举着MTV旗帜的小人，而且它真的保持了平衡。

sentences.en: There's a thing about balance where if you line up the head, the center of the belly, and the center of the foot, you can balance in almost any posture.
sentences.zh: 关于平衡有一个秘诀，如果你把头部、肚脐中心和脚部中心对齐，你几乎可以用任何姿势保持平衡。

sentences.en: And so I just did that, and it was perfect.
sentences.zh: 所以我照着做了，结果非常完美。

sentences.en: But the manufacturer really didn't have a lot of time at this point, and he only got around to making five trophies right before the very first ever video music awards.
sentences.zh: 但此时制造商确实时间紧迫，在第一届音乐电视大奖赛举办前夕，他只来得及做出了五个奖杯。

sentences.en: And there were about 30 awards that were going to be given out.
sentences.zh: 当时大约有30个奖项要颁发。

sentences.en: So what do we do?
sentences.zh: 那我们该怎么办？

sentences.en: They decided that an usher could take each winner off the stage and fetch the moon man each time, and then bring it back on stage during a commercial break.
sentences.zh: 他们决定让礼仪引导员在每次颁奖后将得奖者带下台，顺便拿回登月人奖杯，然后在广告插播期间再把它带回台上。

sentences.en: And this meant they could just keep recycling those same five trophies throughout the course of the night.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们可以在整个晚会上循环使用这仅有的五个奖杯。

sentences.en: We'll never run out.
sentences.zh: 我们永远不会用完。

sentences.en: So I thought that was brilliant.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这太妙了。

sentences.en: Yes, at the very first VMAs, there were only five trophies, and they didn't tell anyone.
sentences.zh: 没错，在第一届VMA上，只有五个奖杯，而且他们没有告诉任何人。

sentences.en: What could possibly go wrong?
sentences.zh: 能出什么岔子呢？

sentences.en: Disaster struck.
sentences.zh: 灾难降临了。

sentences.en: Michael Jackson, Thriller.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·杰克逊，《颤栗》。

sentences.en: Michael Jackson wasn't there, sadly, at the first one, but he won all these awards for Thriller.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，迈克尔·杰克逊当时没有出席第一届颁奖典礼，但他凭借《Thriller》赢得了所有这些奖项。

sentences.en: Diana Ross was sitting in the front, and she was accepting them for him.
sentences.zh: 黛安娜·罗斯坐在前排，由她代为领奖。

sentences.en: Well, I talked to Michael today, and he wants me first to thank you, John.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我今天和迈克尔聊过，他首先让我谢谢你，约翰。

sentences.en: Diana Ross, right in the front row, would go up and down the stairs before the usher could take her off the stage and get the moon man from her.
sentences.zh: 黛安娜·罗斯就坐在第一排，不等礼仪引导员把她请下台并从她手中拿走登月人，她就已经自己上下起台阶了。

sentences.en: And Thriller kept winning more and more awards.
sentences.zh: 而且《Thriller》不断赢得更多的奖项。

sentences.en: And the winner is Michael Jackson for Thriller.
sentences.zh: 获奖的是——迈克尔·杰克逊，凭《Thriller》。

sentences.en: He won a lot in a row, and she had all five statues in her lap.
sentences.zh: 他接连赢了好几个奖，而她的膝盖上已经堆了全部五个奖杯。

sentences.en: So they sent an usher to sneak down to Diana Ross and take the statues back.
sentences.zh: 于是他们派了一个引导员悄悄走到黛安娜·罗斯身边，把奖杯拿回来。

sentences.en: And she starts fighting with him, stands up, as I remember.
sentences.zh: 据我记性所及，她开始和他争抢，并站了起来。

sentences.en: It was like a tug of war, and it was like a real disaster.
sentences.zh: 这就像拔河一样，简直是一场真正的灾难。

sentences.en: And the moon man tug of war got a little bit of airtime, and it was embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 登月人拔河的画面被播出了那么一小会儿，令人尴尬。

sentences.en: But history has mostly forgotten it, because much crazier things have since happened at the VMAs.
sentences.zh: 但历史大体上已经把它淡忘了，因为后来VMA上发生了多得多的疯狂事件。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for giving me a chance to win a VMA award.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你们给我机会赢得VMA奖项。

sentences.en: Yo, Taylor, I'm really happy for you.
sentences.zh: 嘿，泰勒，我真的为你感到高兴。

sentences.en: I'm going to let you finish.
sentences.zh: 我会让你说完。

sentences.en: But Beyoncé had one of the best videos of all time.
sentences.zh: 但碧昂丝拥有史上最棒的音乐录影带之一。

sentences.en: Controversy has become its yearly tradition.
sentences.zh: 争议已经成了它每年的传统。

sentences.en: The whole event worked, you know.
sentences.zh: 整个活动成功了，你知道的。

sentences.en: And I knew that if it was successful, then it would go on.
sentences.zh: 我当时就知道，如果它成功了，它就会延续下去。

sentences.en: It would become like a yearly thing, a tradition, which it actually has.
sentences.zh: 它会变成像一年一度的盛事、一种传统，实际上它也确实如此。

sentences.en: And the moon man has stayed, which is kind of amazing.
sentences.zh: 而且登月人雕像一直保留了下来，这真是挺了不起的。

sentences.en: Honestly, now that MTV is without music, and almost without traditional television,
sentences.zh: 说实话，如今MTV已经没有了音乐，几乎也没有了传统电视节目，

sentences.en: this award ceremony has become a big part of MTV's identity.
sentences.zh: 这个颁奖典礼已经成为了MTV身份认同的很大一部分。

sentences.en: And by now they've figured out how to get all the winners their own personalized awards,
sentences.zh: 到现在，他们已经摸索出了如何为所有获奖者定制专属奖杯的方法，

sentences.en: which is actually a lot harder to plan than you'd think,
sentences.zh: 这其实比你想象的要难得多，

sentences.en: especially when you get into the high-stakes award, like the Oscars.
sentences.zh: 尤其是当你涉足奥斯卡这样高风险的奖项时。

sentences.en: Because, back in Chicago, R.S.
sentences.zh: 因为，远在芝加哥的R.S.

sentences.en: Owens doesn't know in advance who the Oscar winners are.
sentences.zh: 欧文斯公司并不能提前知道谁是奥斯卡得主。

sentences.en: So they've developed a smart solution.
sentences.zh: 所以他们想出了一个聪明的解决方案。

sentences.en: Because there's so few Oscars given out, and there's so few nominees,
sentences.zh: 因为颁发的奥斯卡奖项很少，提名者也很少，

sentences.en: we just engrave plates for all the nominees.
sentences.zh: 我们只需为所有提名者都刻好铭牌。

sentences.en: And the Academy can just quickly screw on the nameplate of the winner and destroy the other nameplates.
sentences.zh: 学院就可以迅速把获奖者的名牌拧上去，并销毁其他名牌。

sentences.en: It's a lot of effort, but then the winners get to have awards that are already personalized.
sentences.zh: 这需要付出很大的努力，但这样一来，获奖者就能拿到已经印有自己名字的奖杯。

sentences.en: Because the most important thing about an award is that it has your name on it.
sentences.zh: 因为奖项最重要的一点，就是上面刻着你的名字。

sentences.en: I think it was Carnegie who said that the one word that the person would always prefer
sentences.zh: 我想是卡耐基说过，一个人永远最喜欢的词，

sentences.en: over all the other words in the vocabulary is his name.
sentences.zh: 胜过词汇表里的所有其他词，那就是他自己的名字。

sentences.en: Dale Carnegie's principle number six from How to Win Friends and Influence People is,
sentences.zh: 戴尔·卡耐基在《如何赢得朋友并影响他人》中的第六条原则是：

sentences.en: remember that a person's name is, to that person,
sentences.zh: 铭记对一个人而言，

sentences.en: the sweetest and most important sound in any language.
sentences.zh: 任何语言中都莫过于他的名字那最甜美、最重要的声音。

sentences.en: That goes a long way into the award business as well.
sentences.zh: 这在颁奖行业同样大有用途。

sentences.en: Because people see their names, not only hear it said, but they actually see it engraved.
sentences.zh: 因为人们不仅能听到别人说出自己的名字，还能亲眼看到它被镌刻出来。

sentences.zh: 我要感谢弗兰克·奥林斯基，他真的帮我核实事实并联系了帕特·戈曼。

sentences.zh: 我还要特别感谢弗雷德·西伯特。

sentences.zh: 哦天哪，还有谁呢？

sentences.zh: 我真的很想感谢萨姆·格林斯潘、凯蒂·明格，你们是最棒的。

sentences.zh: 还有KLW，最棒的公共广播电台；ArcSign建筑与室内设计事务所，
